results.title: Jakarta overtakes Tokyo as world’s most populous city, according to UN | Indonesia | The Guardian
results.label: yes
results.reason: report_index/international_india: UN report on global urbanization trends and megacities.

notes.subject: geography
notes.why_in_news: A UN study re-ranked the world's most populous cities using new methodologies, highlighting the rapid pace of global urbanization.
notes.fact_box: The UN World Urbanisation Prospects 2025 report estimates Jakarta has 42 million people, surpassing Tokyo (33 million) and Dhaka (37 million). The new methodology provides a more internationally comparable delimitation of urban extent.

prelims_pointers.text: Jakarta is estimated to have 42 million people according to the UN World Urbanisation Prospects 2025 report.
The number of megacities (>= 10 million inhabitants) has quadrupled from 8 in 1975 to 33 in 2025.
By 2050, two-thirds of global population growth is projected to occur in cities.
Tokyo's population figure (33 million) includes three neighboring prefectures: Saitama, Chiba, and Kanagawa.

notes.mains_question: Analyze the socio-economic implications of rapid urbanization as evidenced by the shifting global city rankings.

results.title: India-UAE FTA Talks: Market access, gold quota and data sharing reviewed under CEPA - The Hindu
results.label: yes
results.reason: india_foreign_relations/international_india: Bilateral trade agreement talks and economic targets are key.

notes.subject: ir
notes.why_in_news: India and UAE reviewed key aspects of their Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) to deepen bilateral trade and investment.
notes.fact_box: The joint committee meeting discussed market access, data sharing, gold TRQ, and anti-dumping measures under CEPA. Bilateral trade surpassed $100 billion in 2024-25, marking a 19.6% increase from 2023-24.

prelims_pointers.text: CEPA: Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement between India and UAE.
Bilateral trade between India and UAE crossed $100 billion in 2024-25.
The target set for non-oil and non-precious metal trade is $100 billion by 2030.

notes.mains_question: How can strategic economic agreements like CEPA enhance bilateral trade and address contemporary trade challenges between nations?

results.title: Proposal for new design of border fencing under consideration of Centre: BSF IG - The Hindu
results.label: yes
results.reason: internal_security/national: Border fencing upgrade is a national security infrastructure development.

notes.subject: security
notes.why_in_news: The Centre is considering a new design for barbed wire fencing along the India-Bangladesh border to enhance border management due to the aging and weather-affected existing infrastructure.
notes.fact_box: India shares a 4,096 km international border with Bangladesh, of which Tripura has 856 km. The proposal for new fencing is under consideration by the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA). The BSF maintains cordial and cooperative relations with the Bangladesh Border Guard (BGB).

prelims_pointers.text: India shares a 4,096 km international border with Bangladesh.
Tripura shares an 856 km border with Bangladesh.
BSF is the primary agency managing the India-Bangladesh border.
The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) is considering the new fencing design.

notes.mains_question: How crucial is modernizing border infrastructure for effective border management in India's geopolitical context?
